name: Alqama ibn Waqqas al-Laythi
diedNote: died during the caliphate of Abd al-Malik (65–86 AH)

taqrib.ar: ثقة ثبت، من الثانية، أخطأ من زعم أن له صحبة، وقيل إنه ولد في عهد النبي ﷺ
taqrib.en: Reliable and firm, of the second generation. Whoever claimed he was a Companion erred; it is said he was born in the Prophet's lifetime.

verdicts.en: On Ibn Manda counting him a Companion: “this is an error”.

bio: A senior Successor of Madinah who heard Umar deliver this hadith from the pulpit, and is the only person known to have transmitted it from him. Whether he was a Companion was itself debated: Ibn Manda counted him one, Abu Nu'aym called that an error, and Ibn Hajar, who rules against it in the Taqrib and al-Isaba, still notes in Tahdhib al-Tahdhib a sound-looking report that would imply it and asks for the matter to be examined.
